svg.text: GPU OBSERVABILITY & TOKEN FINOPS: DCGM PROFILING (TENSOR VS. DRAM ACTIVE) & OTEL CHARGEBACK
4-Quadrant DCGM Profiling (`1004/1005`) + Weighted Token FinOps Cuts Wasted GPU Spend 59.7%
256x H200 Cluster: Tier 1 Coarse `GPU_UTIL` Only (24.8% True Eff., $640K/mo) vs. Tier 4 DCGM Profiling + FinOps (76.8% Eff., $258K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 Trap: Why `GPU_UTIL = 99%` Is "Fake Busy"
1. `DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL (Field 203)` Measures Presence, Not Work:
• A stuck NCCL spin-wait kernel or `B=1` Decode reports `99%`
`GPU_UTIL` while `PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE` is `2%` & `DRAM_ACTIVE` is `15%`!
2. Blindness to the 4 Hardware Bottleneck Quadrants:
• Without DCGM `1002–1012` hardware performance counters, SREs
spend `185 minutes` guessing whether slow training is network or I/O
3. Unfair Multi-Tenant Cost Allocation on Shared MaaS Pools:
• Charging by raw token count ignores `5x` Output weight & Cache hits
Tier 1 Coarse `GPU_UTIL` Monitoring Failure Impact:
• True Hardware Efficiency (MFU / MBU): Only 24.8%
• Unattributed / Wasted GPU Spend: 52.4% | MTTR: 185 mins
• Monthly 256-GPU Net Cluster TCO: $640,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 4-Quadrant DCGM Profiling & Token FinOps
1. The 4-Quadrant `TENSOR_ACTIVE (1004)` × `DRAM_ACTIVE (1005)` Matrix:
• `High Tensor / Low DRAM`: Healthy Prefill / Training (`MFU >= 60%`)
• `Low Tensor / High DRAM`: Healthy Decode (`MBU >= 72%`)
• `Low Tensor / Low DRAM` (+ High `GPU_UTIL`): Comm / CPU Launch Stall!
2. OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions + Weighted Chargeback:
• Bills tenants by `0.2*N_cached + 1.0*N_uncached + 5.0*N_out`
incentivizing teams to adopt Prefix Caching & concise outputs!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (256x H200):
• True Hardware Efficiency: 76.8% (3.10x higher than Tier 1!)
• Bottleneck Diagnosis MTTR: 3.5 mins | Wasted Spend: 1.8%
• Monthly Net Cluster TCO: $258,000 / mo (-59.7% savings)
